newsitem.title: USA: Famous Dave's stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Famous Dave's stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Okabena Partnership K, a Minneapolis, Minn., investment firm, said Wednesday it held the equivalent of 10.7 percent in Famous Dave's of America Inc, or 622,700 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its stake consisted of 282,750 restricted shares -- those which can be sold only after a holding period -- purchased in July at $3.50 a share and 170,000 units, each consisting of one common share and a warrant to buy an additional share.
The units were purchased on October 21 at prices ranging from $6.50 to $11.125 a unit, according to the filing.
The group said it holds the stake for investment.
